## (2) Instrument decisions
1. Fully self-contained fresh re-implementation (rules + fixpoint + generators + evaluators) rather than importing qa023_probe.zig / qa023_pinrule.zig: gives the independent-reimplementation property the project counts on, and is the only way to get 3x3 (neither prior instrument does 3x3).
2. Single true game root (F1-CENSUS-GAP new+1: V=2,583) rather than the probe's 4-root (2,586) or pinrule's 42-root (2,622) seeding. Consequence: 3 colour-inversion 'mirror-unreachable' states (empty-White side states unreachable from the Black root) — a reachability boundary artifact, not a kernel defect; the both-reachable inversion check is 0.
3. Alpha-beta (T3-style) primary evaluator, plain minimax (T2-style) as provenance cross-check: the hand-verified witness trees ARE alpha-beta trees (22/33 nodes), and alpha-beta is exact. Plain minimax exhausts 20M nodes on the witness — the honest cost.
4. Tests live outside the generic Goban struct so they run only on 3x2 (fast); 3x3 would make a unit-test battery minutes-long.
5. Big-stack thread (256 MB) for main: the truncated evaluator recurses along simple paths whose length is bounded by the reachable count (~74k at 3x3), and a deep continuation can exceed the default 8 MB stack.

## (3) The degenerate-parity near-miss (recorded because it is instructive)
The first seeded-control seed tried was 'value += parity of arrival length'. The probe did NOT flag it — correctly: side toggles on every move from the root, so path-length parity equals the state's side; it is a tuple function, not a history consultation. A sufficiency probe calibrated on such a seed would be calibrated on a non-seed. Replaced with two genuine arrival-consulting seeds: len_gt_dist (value +1 iff arrival longer than the shortest) and pass_member (value +1 iff the arrival contains a pass). Both detected at 3x2 (152 and 8 disagreeing pairs); len_gt_dist detected at 3x3 (32 pairs) while pass_member's feature was uniform in the 3x3 within-budget sample — the seeded verdict is OR across seeds, with per-seed numbers reported.
